prompt: Implement pause and resume for the recurring job scheduler. Pausing a job holds it and its transitive dependents, including dependents registered later. Each explicit pause is independent and idempotent; resuming removes only that job's explicit hold. In-flight runs may complete normally, retaining retry deadlines and attempt counts; overdue work becomes eligible when all applicable holds are removed, subject to dependency readiness. Status must report effective pause state. Unknown jobs return ErrUnknownJob. Run `go test -count=1 ./...` offline from the repository root. Do not edit, delete, or skip protected tests.
